# How to Register and Activate Your Absher Account: 2026 Guide

Feb 27, 2026

Reviewed by[Mohammed Ameen Villan](https://ksaexpats.com/author/mohammed-ameen-villan/)

If you’re living or working in Saudi Arabia, creating an Absher account isn’t just helpful—it’s practically essential. This government platform has become the digital backbone for accessing over 330 Ministry of Interior services, from renewing your Iqama to [checking traffic fines](https://ksaexpats.com/check-traffic-violation-number-in-saudi-arabia/), all without standing in long queues.

But here’s what confuses most people: registration and activation are two separate steps. You can create an account online in minutes, but you’ll need to activate it before you can actually use most services. This guide walks you through both processes, explains who can register, and answers the most common questions about Absher in 2026.

## What is Absher and Why Does Everyone in Saudi Arabia Need It?

Absher (أبشر) means “at your service” in Arabic, and that’s exactly what it delivers. Launched in 2010 by the Ministry of Interior and operated by the National Information Center, this platform has transformed how residents interact with government services in Saudi Arabia.

Think of Absher as your digital ID card, visa office, traffic department, and civil affairs office all rolled into one app. Whether you need to renew your residency permit, book a Jawazat appointment, add a dependent to your Iqama, or even [register for Hajj](https://ksaexpats.com/hajj-2026-1447ah-registration-for-residents/), Absher handles it. The platform now serves over 20 million users and continues adding new features regularly.

## Who Can Register for an Absher Account?

The good news is that Absher is open to almost everyone in Saudi Arabia. Here’s who can create an account:

**Saudi Citizens** can register using their national ID number. This gives them access to the full range of citizen services.

**Expatriate Residents** holding valid Iqamas can register, including dependent family members. Yes, this includes spouses and children on your sponsorship—Jawazat updated this policy to allow dependents to have their own accounts.

**GCC Nationals** residing in or visiting Saudi Arabia can register using their ID or border number.

**Visit Visa Holders** can create accounts using their border number. This is particularly useful if you’re on an extended business or tourist visit and need to access certain services.

The only requirements are a valid ID/Iqama/border number, a Saudi mobile number registered in your name, and an email address. That’s it.

## Step-by-Step: How to Register Your Absher Account Online

Creating your Absher account is straightforward and takes about 10 minutes. Here’s exactly what to do:

### Visit the Official Absher Website

Go to [absher.sa](https://www.absher.sa/) and click on “Individuals” on the right side of the homepage. Make sure you’re on the official government site—there are fake sites out there.

### Start the Registration Process

Look for the “New User?” link below the green login button. Click it to open the registration form.

### Enter Your Personal Information

You’ll need to provide:

- **ID Number**: Your Iqama number if you’re an expat, national ID for citizens, or border number for visitors
- **Mobile Number**: This must be a Saudi [mobile number registered under your name](https://ksaexpats.com/check-how-many-mobile-sim-registered-on-iqama-citc-website/) (STC, Mobily, Zain, or Virgin Mobile)
- **Email Address**: Use a valid email you check regularly—you’ll receive important notifications here

### Create Your Login Credentials

Now set up your account access:

- **Username**: Choose a username using only Latin characters and numbers. It must start with a letter and be at least 8 characters long. Pick something you’ll remember.
- **Password**: Your password must be at least 8 characters and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, and a number. Don’t use special characters like @, !, or %. A good example: Absher2026pass

### Select Your Preferred Language

Choose whether you want the platform to display in English or Arabic. You can change this later in your account settings.

### Complete the Verification

Enter the CAPTCHA code shown in the image. Read and accept the terms and conditions, then click “Next.”

### Verify Your Mobile Number

Absher will send a verification code to your mobile via SMS. Enter this code to confirm your phone number and complete the registration.

![Absher Registartion Steps; Form Fill up](https://ksaexpats.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/absher-registration-779x1024.png)

That’s it—you’ve successfully created your Absher account. However, here’s the catch: you can’t use most services yet. Your account needs to be activated first.

## How to Activate Your Absher Account: All Methods Explained

This is where many people get stuck. Registration gives you an account, but activation gives you access. Think of it as getting a key made versus actually using it to unlock a door.

The Saudi government offers multiple activation methods to make it convenient for everyone. Here are all your options:

### Method 1: Activate Using the Nafath App

This is the simplest and most popular method as of now. Nafath is Saudi Arabia’s unified national digital identity platform.

**To activate via Nafath:**

- Download the Nafath app from Google Play or the App Store
- Open the app and go to **Digital Identity Account Management**
- Select “**Digital Identity Activation**“
- Enter your Iqama number and new mobile number
- Complete the verification using the code sent to your phone
- Use your phone’s camera for face verification
- Your account will be activated within 10 minutes

![absher activation using nafath](https://ksaexpats.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/absher-activation-using-nafath-1024x1024.png)

This method is particularly convenient if you’re tech-savvy and want to avoid physical locations.

### Method 2: Activate Through Absher Self-Service Kiosks

This is another best method. There are over 420 self-service kiosk machines placed throughout Saudi Arabia in shopping malls, airports, government offices, and Jawazat centers.

**Here’s how to activate using a kiosk:**

- Locate the nearest kiosk machine (use the Absher website’s kiosk locator or check major malls like Red Sea Mall in Jeddah, Riyadh Gallery, or Al Rashid Mall in Dammam)
- Tap the screen and select your preferred language (English or Arabic)
- Enter your Iqama number or national ID
- Place your right index finger on the fingerprint scanner, then repeat with your left index finger
- Enter the mobile number you registered with Absher
- Input the OTP (verification code) sent to your mobile
- Wait for the confirmation message

![absher kiosk](https://ksaexpats.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/absher-kiosk-1024x1024.png)

Your account is now activated. The whole process takes about 3-5 minutes.

### Method 3: Activate at Jawazat (Passport Office)

If you prefer human assistance or don’t have kiosk access, you can visit any Jawazat office in Saudi Arabia.

**Follow these steps:**

- Book an appointment through the Absher website or app (look for “Activate Cell Phone Number of Absher Account”)
- Visit the Jawazat office at your scheduled time
- Bring your physical Iqama or national ID and your Absher username
- Present these documents at the designated activation counter
- The officer will verify your identity and activate your account immediately

No appointment fees are charged for this service.

### Method 4: Activate Through Your Bank Account

Several major Saudi banks offer Absher activation through their banking channels. This is perfect if you’d rather handle it from home or your office.

**Banks offering Absher activation include:**

- Al Rajhi Bank
- Riyad Bank
- Saudi National Bank (SNB/Al Ahli Bank)
- Bank AlBilad
- Bank AlJazira

**You can activate through these channels:**

**Online Banking**: Log into your bank’s website, navigate to Government Services or MOI Services, select Absher Activation, verify your information (Iqama number and mobile number), and confirm. You’ll receive an SMS confirmation.

**Mobile Banking App**: Most banks now offer this through their apps (like Al Rajhi app). Open the app, go to Services, select Absher Registration/Activation, confirm your details, and you’ll get instant activation.

**ATM**: Visit your bank’s ATM, insert your card, select “Other Services” or “Government Services,” choose “Absher Activation,” verify your information on screen, and complete the process. An SMS will confirm activation.

**Phone Banking**: Some banks like Al Rajhi offer activation via phone (call 920003344 for Al Rajhi). Enter your customer number and PIN, then follow the voice prompts to activate.

**Also Read:** [How to Change Your Absher Mobile Number Without Logging In](https://ksaexpats.com/how-to-change-your-mobile-number-in-absher-without-login/)

## How to Log Into Your Absher Account

Once your account is activated, logging in is simple:

- Visit [absher.sa](https://www.absher.sa/) or open the Absher mobile app
- Click “Individuals” and select your preferred language
- Enter your username and password
- Click “Login”
- Enter the OTP verification code sent to your registered mobile number
- You’re in

The platform uses two-factor authentication for security, which is why you’ll always need access to your registered mobile number to log in.

## Can You Register Absher Without an Iqama?

This is one of the most frequently asked questions. The short answer is: yes, but with limitations.

If you’re a visitor to Saudi Arabia, you can register using your border number instead of an Iqama. This [border number](https://ksaexpats.com/check-your-border-number-online/) is issued when you enter the Kingdom and can be found on your entry stamp or visa documentation.

However, if you’re a resident who hasn’t received your Iqama yet but has an Iqama number issued to you, you can use that number to register. Some people successfully register while their Iqama card is still being processed, as long as they have the Iqama number.

GCC nationals can use their national ID numbers from their home countries to register for Absher services.

**Also Read:** [How to Change Your Mobile Number in Absher](https://ksaexpats.com/how-to-update-mobile-number-with-moi-absher-eservices/)

## Can You Access Absher From Outside Saudi Arabia?

Yes, you can access your Absher account from anywhere in the world. The platform is designed to work internationally, which is helpful for checking documents, reviewing information, or managing certain services while you’re traveling or on vacation outside Saudi Arabia.

However, keep in mind that some services may have restrictions when accessed from abroad. For instance, certain appointment bookings or services requiring physical presence in the Kingdom might not be available when you’re outside Saudi Arabia.

The Absher mobile app works internationally as well, though you’ll need internet access and the ability to receive SMS verification codes on your Saudi mobile number.

## How to Change Your Mobile Number in Absher

Life happens—you might lose your phone, change carriers, or simply want a new number. Here is how to update your registered mobile number.

### Through Nafath App

The Nafath app also allows mobile number updates:

- Open the Nafath app
- Go to **Digital Identity Account Management**
- Choose “**Digital Identity Mobile Number Update**“
- Follow the prompts to change your number with biometric verification

![absher mobile number update using nafath](https://ksaexpats.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/absher-mobile-number-update-using-nafath-1024x1024.png)

Your number should be updated within 10 minutes using this method.

**Also Read:** [How to Change Absher Mobile Number Using Nafath App](https://ksaexpats.com/change-absher-mobile-number-using-nafath/)

### If You’ve Lost Access to Your Number

Don’t panic—you can still update it:

- Find the nearest Absher self-service kiosk
- Select your language preference
- Choose “Update Mobile” from the menu
- Enter your Iqama number
- Scan your right index finger, then left index finger for verification
- Enter your new mobile number
- Input the OTP sent to your new number
- Confirm the change

The kiosk method works even if you can’t log into your account because it verifies your identity through fingerprint scanning.

## What Services Can You Access After Activation?

Once your Absher account is fully activated, you gain access to over 330 services. Here are the most commonly used:

**Residency Services**: Renew your Iqama, check Iqama expiry dates, transfer sponsorship, issue exit-reentry visas, final exit visas, and manage dependent visas.

**Passport Services**: [Update passport information (naqal maloomath)](https://ksaexpats.com/naqal-maloomat-online-by-absher-app/) and check passport status.

**Traffic Services**: Check traffic violations, view your driving license details, renew vehicle registration (Istimara), and transfer vehicle ownership.

**Appointment Booking**: Schedule appointments at Jawazat offices, Civil Affairs departments, and traffic departments without waiting in queues.

**Family Services**: Register newborns, add dependents to your Iqama, manage sponsored employees (for business owners), and update family information.

**National Address**: Register your national address, which is now mandatory for many services as of 2026.

**Digital Documents**: Access digital copies of your Iqama, national ID, vehicle registration, and driving license. These digital versions are legally valid in most situations.

**Inquiry Services**: [Check your Iqama status](https://ksaexpats.com/iqama-update-with-al-rajhi-bank-using-al-rajhi-mobile-app/), verify employee information if you’re a sponsor, view your civil status records, and check if you have any travel restrictions.

**Report Services**: Report various issues including lost documents, illegal recruitment, and electronic crimes.

## Absher Mobile App vs. Website: Which Should You Use?

Both the Absher app and website offer the same core services, but each has advantages.

**The Absher Mobile App** is available for both Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store). It’s updated regularly and the app is ideal for quick tasks like checking your Iqama expiry, paying traffic fines, or accessing your digital documents on the go. It’s designed with security in mind and includes biometric login options (fingerprint/face recognition) on compatible devices.

**The Absher Website** works better for complex tasks like filling out lengthy forms, uploading documents, or managing multiple services at once. The larger screen makes navigation easier, especially when you need to review detailed information or print documents.

Many regular users keep both options available—the app for daily quick checks and the website for more involved transactions.

## Tips for Managing Your Absher Account Smoothly

**Keep Your Mobile Number Active**: Your registered mobile is your lifeline to the account. If you change numbers, update it in Absher immediately.

**Enable Notifications**: Turn on SMS and app notifications so you don’t miss important alerts about Iqama renewals, traffic fines, or document expirations.

**Register Your National Address**: As of January 2026, having a [registered national address](https://ksaexpats.com/register-national-address-saudi-arabia/) is mandatory for many services. Do this early through the SPL (Saudi Post) system via Absher.

**Check Your Account Regularly**: Even if you don’t have immediate needs, log in monthly to stay aware of upcoming renewals, new notifications, or any issues.

**Save Your Digital Documents**: [Download and save copies of your **digital Iqama**](https://ksaexpats.com/steps-to-download-digital-muqeem-id-on-your-smartphone/), driving license, and other documents to your phone. They’re valid for verification in most situations.

**Use Strong Passwords**: Don’t use simple passwords like “Absher123.” Mix uppercase, lowercase, and numbers for better security.

**Never Share Your Credentials**: Absher accounts contain sensitive personal information. Don’t give your username and password to anyone, including friends or coworkers who offer to “help.”

## Final Thoughts

Creating and activating your Absher account in 2026 is straightforward. Once activated, Absher becomes your gateway to hassle-free government services in Saudi Arabia. From visa renewals to traffic fines, from family registrations to digital documents, having an active Absher account isn’t just helpful—it’s essential for anyone living or working in the Kingdom.

**Important Note**: Government procedures and requirements can change. Always verify the latest information on the official Absher website (absher.sa) or contact the Ministry of Interior support line at +966 920020405 for the most up-to-date guidance.
